integrity: A complete public full-text 2016 same-system article was inspected through its exact equations, equilibrium cubic, stability regimes, periodicity diagrams, Lyapunov-exponent analysis, chaotic example, and asymptotic limit-cycle section; targeted full-text searches found no invariant-measure, moment, variance, or average formulation. The foundational convection paper was checked for model provenance and a day-resolved public-online date. A 2026 same-system mathematical article was compared at stated-result level for invariant algebraic surfaces and global Poincaré-ball dynamics. The three conditional regressions, exact moment chain, speed-defect shell, sharp positive-root ceiling, and equality case were independently reconstructed, and all algebra plus the published-example root calculation was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence or uniqueness of chaotic attractors.
The sharp equilibrium-root ceiling assumes \(c>0\); the symmetric case \(c=0\) has different equality geometry.
The identities constrain selected first and second moments rather than the full invariant distribution.
The foundational 1990 article was compared through its public abstract and metadata rather than a complete searchable full text in the checked route.
A short equivalent stationary-moment identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Sharp equilibrium-root RMS ceiling and stationary defect shell in the Ehrhard–Müller system
